title: Case: Recipient has been given two different delivery days for a two-person delivery
context: An oak wardrobe on a two-person delivery was rebooked at the recipient's request. Someone must be home to receive it and the recipient can take only one day off work.
initial_request: Sorry to chase. I need to tell my manager tonight which day I'm off, I can only do one of them not both, and somebody has to be in for the two man delivery. Is it Wednesday morning or Thursday afternoon? Just tell me which one and I'll book it.

acceptable_actions.summary: Set booking SB-2713 (Thursday 16 April, 12:00–16:00) against the route plan and customer text (Wednesday 15 April, 08:00–12:00) and ask Thistlecombe to confirm the one valid slot and correct the other record tonight.

must: Quotes both slots with their sources: booking SB-2713 for Thursday 2026-04-16 12:00–16:00 UTC, and the route plan and customer text for Wednesday 2026-04-15 08:00–12:00
Asks Thistlecombe to confirm which single slot is valid and to have the other record corrected
Says the recipient can take only one day off and needs the answer this evening, with the earlier slot starting 08:00 the next morning
must_not: Tells the recipient the delivery is on Wednesday, or that it is on Thursday
Asks Dispatch to move DL-7348 on the route plan
Advises the recipient to keep both days free or to take a day off on the strength of either record
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: DL-7348 (TG-5866, two-person delivery) has two different dates on record. Your confirmation this morning gives Thursday 2026-04-16, 12:00–16:00 UTC, booking ref SB-2713. Dispatch report it on the two-person van plan for Wednesday 2026-04-15, 08:00–12:00, loaded on Monday, with no Thursday entry, and the recipient has received a text giving the Wednesday slot. Please confirm which single slot is valid and have the other record corrected. The recipient, Wystan Larkham, can take only one day off work and has to tell his employer this evening; the Wednesday window opens at 08:00 tomorrow. I have not told him either date.

rationale: Rule-made from gen-103: people, organisations and references renamed. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
